messages:
Ivy (Design): quick idea: move invoice download into a persistent action slot beside scope toggle so it's always visible. compact token pill stacks tokens over fiat to save width. figma link in thread.
Alex (PM): Finance asked for obvious download flow. good start. mobile behavior?
Ivy (Design): mobile -> full width CTA in header. desktop -> icon+label next to scope. will show both variants.
Priya (FE): note: collapse left rail at <=980px to icon-only to reclaim width. ensure tab order: scope -> invoice -> filters.
Derek (Eng): perf FYI: for very long tables virtualize rows and only make one element sticky to avoid repaint issues.
Sam (Content): CTA copy candidate: "Download invoice (PDF / CSV)". aria-label suggestion: "Download billing invoice for selected scope and period".
a11y-bot: Reminder: use aria-pressed for scope toggles and ensure invoice button is reachable within two tab stops.
Ivy (Design): action items: update mock with divider between sparkline and pill, add aria notes, provide mobile header variant.
Alex (PM): Acceptance for sprint: invoice within two tab stops, mobile header CTA present, aria-labels implemented. compact preference deferred to settings next sprint.
Priya (FE): I’ll draft component API and keyboard flow.
Derek (Eng): I’ll add virtualization + backend flag proposal for show_fiat.
Sam (Content): I’ll finalize copy and localization keys.
Ivy (Design): added to tomorrow’s design review agenda.
